For each evaluated condition line in this function, report which BRANCH OUTCOMES were executed across the entire test suite. In `branches_executed`, use `"true"` if that condition evaluated to true at least once (so execution entered the `if` block body for that line), and `"false"` if it evaluated to false at least once (so execution skipped the body and continued past the `if` block). If both happened across different evaluations of the same line, include both values. In the three tests, `unexpected_errors` is empty in two cases and non-empty in one case, so `if unexpected_errors:` executes both false and true branches. After that, `reason_str` is non-empty in all three cases: either it comes from unsupported errors, or it is reassigned to the unexpected-error count, so `if reason_str:` only takes the true branch.
